description: This file defines an API client for a frontend application, wrapping axios calls to communicate with a backend server. It provides functions for creating/updating user profiles, submitting game scores, and retrieving the leaderboard.

methods.name: createApi()
methods.description: Creates and returns an API client object with methods to interact with backend endpoints.

methods.name: ensureProfile(username)
methods.description: Creates or updates a user profile by calling the backend API; falls back to GET if POST fails.

methods.name: submitScore({ username, score, moves })
methods.description: Submits a game score to the backend server.

methods.name: getLeaderboard()
methods.description: Retrieves the game leaderboard from the backend.

ctags.name: submitScore
ctags.pattern: /^  async function submitScore({ username, score, moves }) {$/
